messages:
srin: Drafting the internal announce for next week's micro-window. Need quick signoff on the RN bullets + pin guidance. Low drama but want clear rollback lanes.

alex: paste the RN snippet and the pin decision? will skim.

srin: sure — here's the lead blurb and the technical bits:
```
- Feature: request-level batching improvements (runtime v2.14)
- Benefit: 12-18% median p95 token latency reduction on xlarge GPUs
- Opt-in: customers on Dedicated will be auto-upgraded; Hosted will see traffic migrated over 48h
- Pinning: customers can pin to runtime v2.13 via /pin API through 2026-05-31
- Rollback: automatic fallback to v2.13 via routing policy; on-call may force immediate cutover if needed
```

alex: LGTM on bullets. two tiny asks: add commit SHA for the canary image, and clarify that EU region cutover is 03:00 UTC.

maria: also pls mention the deploybot cue + deploy window so support can set pager overlap.

srin: ok adding both. canary SHA: `sha256:ab12c3...ef45`. window: 2026-04-07 02:00-04:00 UTC for staging, 03:00 UTC EU primary cutover. deploybot will post start/finish.

emmab: for rollback wording — instead of "auto-fallback", can we say "automatic fallback to v2.13 (controlled by routing policy)"? ops prefers explicit control.

srin: good call. updated: "automatic fallback to v2.13 via routing policy; on-call may force immediate cutover if needed."

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary deploy started for runtime v2.14 canary-1 at 8765440015. Monitoring hooks: latency, 5xx, token-cost delta.

ops-oncall: I'm on shift during the window. Please tag me in the final announce. I'll prepare a short rollback playbook:
- Step 1: run `./scripts/pin-runtime --version 2.13 --scope hosting`
- Step 2: verify traffic funnels and KV cache warmup (5-7 min)
- Step 3: escalate to infra if errors persist >15m

alex: perfect. can we add a single-line customer-facing blurb for the hosted status page?

maria: I'll craft the internal announce + customer blurb after the SHA and exact window are in. srin — can you push the final bullets by EOD? @ops-oncall i'll ping you in the thread when done. :thumbsup:

srin: will do. final draft back in 30m. thanks all.
